meta.known_bug: compute_factors is not self-bounding at as_of for the regime columns: instrument_regime.classify_regimes classifies each instrument's whole history and labels only the frame's max date, so with bars after as_of the as_of row's regime, regime_distance_bull and regime_distance_bear are NULL. With the same bars truncated at as_of they are NEUTRAL / 0.0032306171918009426 / 0.003137655413468552 (unrounded); every other column is identical. Callers must pass bars <= as_of (house rule 5). This golden records the current output.
meta.notes: no look-ahead: ten sessions after as_of (a tenfold spike) are in the bars and the calendar and must not reach any as_of value; 402's last bar is five sessions before as_of so it has no output row. Inputs are JSON and each case is recomputed from them; a raise is stored as {"raises": {"type", "message"}} (pydantic: "errors" instead of "message"). Polars frames are {columns, dtypes, rows}; pandas frames add index and write NA/NaN/NaT as null. Prices: close is adjusted, close_raw is the exchange print (house rule 6).
